subject: maths
question: On selling of 18 pens at Rs.360, there is a loss equal to the cost of 3 pens. What is the cost price of a pen?
solution:
Given:

Loss on selling 18 pens = CP of 3 pens.

Concept used:

Loss = CP - SP

Calculation:

(C.P. of 18 pens) - (S.P. of 18 pens) = (C.P. of 3 pens)

⇒ CP of 15 pens = SP of 18 pens

⇒ CP (1 pen)/SP (1 pen) = 18/15 = 6/5

According to the question,

SP (1 pen) = 360/18 = 20

∴ CP of 1 pen = 6/5 × 20 = 24

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
